replacements.Algunas capacidades parecen aparecer de: Some capabilities seem to appear suddenly when a model reaches a certain size. But whether that abrupt threshold is real or depends on how we measure it is an open question with important consequences.
replacements.Una tarea concreta a distintas escalas: One specific task at different scales
replacements.Pregunta: \"¿Cuántas r hay en la palabra: Question: "How many r letters are in the word strawberry?"
replacements.El modelo no cuenta caracteres; predice: The model does not count characters; it predicts the most likely response from the text distribution.
replacements.El modelo acierta el conteo, pero la res: The model gets the count right, but the response does not provide solid evidence that it is operating over character positions.
replacements.\"Hay 3 letras r en strawberry: en la po: "There are 3 r letters in strawberry: at positions 3, 8 and 9."
replacements.A esta escala aparece la capacidad de ra: At this scale, the ability to reason about the internal structure of words appears.
replacements.El debate: ¿cómo lees esa mejora?: The debate: how should you interpret that improvement?
replacements.Emergencia real: la capacidad no existe: Real emergence: the capability does not exist below the threshold and appears suddenly
replacements.Con métrica binaria (correcto o no), el: With a binary metric (correct or not), the jump looks abrupt. The model "cannot" and suddenly "can".
replacements.Implicación: hay umbrales reales de capa: Implication: there are real capability thresholds that cannot be extrapolated from smaller scales.
replacements.Artefacto de métrica: la mejora es gradu: Metric artifact: improvement is gradual but the binary metric makes it look abrupt
replacements.Métrica: crédito parcial (cuántas r dete: Metric: partial credit (how many r letters it detects correctly)
replacements.Con crédito parcial, el progreso es cont: With partial credit, progress is continuous. The model improves at each scale, although it does not reach 100% until larger scales.
replacements.Implicación: no hay \"magia\" en los umb: Implication: there is no "magic" in large-scale thresholds. Emergence may be an artifact of choosing metrics that do not capture partial improvements.
replacements.Si la emergencia es real, no puedes pred: If emergence is real, you cannot predict when a dangerous capability will appear in larger models. If it is a metric artifact, you can track gradual progress and anticipate it. The difference has direct consequences for safety and planning in the field.
